claims.text: The OIG issued DOWIG-2026-081 on 12 May 2026 recording an eighth consecutive disclaimer of opinion and 26 material weaknesses for FY2025.
The FY2025 audit identified 26 material weaknesses: 10 in management responsibility and asset accountability, 6 in information technology, and 10 in accounting.

One of the ten accounting material weaknesses is titled 'Unsupported Accounting Adjustments'; the report states that in the last two quarters of FY2025 the Department's adjustments totalled more than $859 billion.

claims.text: 'Universe of Transactions' - the complete set of all transactions falling within audit scope - is itself a standing material weakness, meaning the Department cannot establish what its own transaction population is.

A standing 'Universe of Transactions' material weakness is the accounting equivalent of an unindexed archive: it means no auditor and no oversight committee can prove a negative about DoD spending, because the population against which a search would run is not known to exist in complete form. Reasoning: the material weakness is defined by the auditors as inability to establish the complete transaction set; any assertion that no funds flowed to an undisclosed activity would require exactly that set.
